title: Eventual equality of morphisms, [stacks-project]
statement:
For every $\lambda\geq\lambda_{\varphi=\psi}$, the base changes of
$\varphi_{\lambda_0}$ and $\psi_{\lambda_0}$ to $S_\lambda$ are equal.

proof.text: By the construction in [def-nagata-morphism-equality-stage], for each pair $(j,k)$ there are the quasi-compact opens $W_1=\varphi_{\lambda_0}^{-1}(V_{jk})$ and $W_2=\psi_{\lambda_0}^{-1}(V_{jk})$ of $X_{\lambda_0}$ with equal inverse images in $X$, the stage $\lambda_{jk}=\lambda_{W_1=W_2}$, a finite affine open cover $\{U_{jkl}\}_l$ of $W_{1,\lambda_{jk}}\cap W_{2,\lambda_{jk}}$, and for each $l$ and each generator $b\in G_{jk}$ a stage $\mu_{jklb}\geq\lambda_{jk}$ at which the two pullbacks of $b$ to $\Gamma(U_{jkl,\mu_{jklb}},\mathcal O)$ (through $\varphi_{\lambda_0}$ and through $\psi_{\lambda_0}$) are equal. By [lemma-nagata-directed-finite-upper-bound], $\lambda_{\varphi=\psi}=u(F)$ satisfies $\lambda_0\leq\lambda_{\varphi=\psi}$, $\lambda_{jk}\leq\lambda_{\varphi=\psi}$ and $\mu_{jklb}\leq\lambda_{\varphi=\psi}$ for all $j,k,l,b$.

Let $\lambda\geq\lambda_{\varphi=\psi}$; then $\lambda\geq\lambda_{jk}=\lambda_{W_1=W_2}$ for every $(j,k)$. Apply [lemma-nagata-qc-open-eq-eventually] with the qcqs scheme $X_{\lambda_0}$ in the role of the scheme called $Y_{\lambda_0}$ there (the opens $W_1,W_2$ are quasi-compact with equal inverse images in $X$, as recorded in [def-nagata-morphism-equality-stage]): the inverse images $W_{1,\lambda}$ and $W_{2,\lambda}$ in $X_\lambda$ are equal, so $W_{1,\lambda}=W_{1,\lambda}\cap W_{2,\lambda}$, which is the inverse image of $W_{1,\lambda_{jk}}\cap W_{2,\lambda_{jk}}$ and hence is covered by the opens $U_{jkl,\lambda}$, $l$ varying. Since the $V_{jk}$ cover $Y_{\lambda_0}$, the $W_1=\varphi_{\lambda_0}^{-1}(V_{jk})$ cover $X_{\lambda_0}$, so the $U_{jkl,\lambda}$ ($j,k,l$ varying) form an open cover of $X_\lambda$ with $\varphi_{\lambda_0}$ and $\psi_{\lambda_0}$ both mapping the image of $U_{jkl,\lambda}$ in $X_{\lambda_0}$ into $V_{jk}$.

Fix $(j,k,l)$ and write $p\colon U_{jkl,\lambda}\to X_{\lambda_0}$ for the projection. For $b\in G_{jk}$, the images in $\Gamma(U_{jkl,\lambda},\mathcal O)$ of the two pullbacks of $b$ are the images under the transition map $\Gamma(U_{jkl,\mu_{jklb}},\mathcal O)\to\Gamma(U_{jkl,\lambda},\mathcal O)$ (as $\mu_{jklb}\leq\lambda$) of elements that are equal at stage $\mu_{jklb}$, hence equal. The composites $\varphi_{\lambda_0}\circ p,\ \psi_{\lambda_0}\circ p\colon U_{jkl,\lambda}\to V_{jk}=\operatorname{Spec}B_{jk}$ (target affine) correspond to ring maps $B_{jk}\to\Gamma(U_{jkl,\lambda},\mathcal O)$; both composites lie over $T_j$, so these are $R_j$-algebra maps, and as they agree on the $R_j$-algebra generators $G_{jk}$ they are equal. Hence $\varphi_{\lambda_0}\circ p=\psi_{\lambda_0}\circ p$. The base changes $\varphi_\lambda,\psi_\lambda\colon X_\lambda\to Y_\lambda=Y_{\lambda_0}\times_{S_{\lambda_0}}S_\lambda$ restricted to $U_{jkl,\lambda}$ have the same composite with the projection to $S_\lambda$ (both are $S_\lambda$-morphisms) and with the projection to $Y_{\lambda_0}$ (namely $\varphi_{\lambda_0}\circ p=\psi_{\lambda_0}\circ p$), so they are equal by the universal property of the fibre product. Since the $U_{jkl,\lambda}$ cover $X_\lambda$ (step 2) and morphisms of schemes agreeing on each member of an open cover are equal, $\varphi_\lambda=\psi_\lambda$.

split_report.summary: Expanded the imported proof into three steps. The definition supplies the finite target and common-inverse-image covers, generator lists, witness stages, and selected upper bound; the finite-upper-bound lemma supplies domination of every required stage; the quasi-compact-open eventual-equality lemma supplies equality of inverse-image opens. The final local ring-map and affine-cover extensionality argument is elementary from these data. No new nodes were needed.
